dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can you pick up my younger brother at the airport tomorrow?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈpɪk ˈʌp maɪ ˈjʌŋɡər ˈbrʌðər ət ði ˈɛrpɔːrt təˈmɑːroʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure! What does he look like?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr! ˈwʌt dʌz hiː ˈlʊk laɪk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He's tall, and he has curly brown hair.
dialogue.reading: hiːz ˈtɔːl, ənd hiː ˈhæz ˈkɜːrli ˈbraʊn ˈhɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, a short beard. And he wears glasses.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈbɪrd. ənd hiː ˈwɛrz ˈɡlæsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Does he look like you?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. dʌz hiː ˈlʊk laɪk ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A little. People say we have the same eyes.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ wiː ˈhæv ðə ˈseɪm ˈaɪz.
